question: Why did Bhallaladeva want to kill Amarendra Baahubali?
reference_answer: Bhallaladeva feared that Amarendra Baahubali would remain a threat to his power because the people loved him.

question: Why did Kattappa kill Amarendra Baahubali?
reference_answer: Kattappa killed Amarendra Baahubali because he was ordered to do so and felt bound by his duty to the royal family.

question: Who was Mahendra Baahubali?
reference_answer: Mahendra Baahubali was the son of Amarendra Baahubali and Devasena. He grew up as Shivudu without knowing his royal identity.
